verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state official clients exist for both TypeScript (npm install supermemory) and Python (pip install supermemory), wrapping the same REST API, and code snippets throughout (add/search) show a consistent client interface. However, all shown code examples are JS/TS-only with no equivalent Python snippet, and there's no independent corroboration of full API parity between the two SDKs. Missing for 10: Python-specific code examples demonstrating identical operations, independent/third-party confirmation of SDK feature parity.
